messages.content: Hi, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are your blood sugars looking this week? Any readings you want to share or anything on your mind?

Pretty frustrated honestly. My insurance denied coverage for test strips last week and I just got the rejection letter. Only got a few left so I've been rationing. Checked this morning and I was at 194.

I'm logging that 194 for this morning — thank you for checking even with the strips running low. I have to be upfront: insurance claims and coverage denials are outside what I'm able to help with. You'd need to call the number on your insurance card or reach out to your clinic's billing department directly for that. I know that's not what you were hoping to hear.
Yeah figured. Do you know who at the clinic handles it? Also I did take my metformin this morning like usual.

Good to hear on the metformin — logging that. I don't have a way to look up clinic staff contacts, so calling the main clinic line and asking for billing is your best route. They should be able to point you to the right person to appeal or resubmit.
Alright. Guess I'll call tomorrow. Thanks for at least listening.
Of course — it's a genuinely stressful situation and you're handling it. Your reading and medication are logged. I'll reach out again same time next week. Take care out there.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
